short.en: Fewer young people have registered to vote in next year's election than in 2023 - are young people losing faith in democracy?
short.zh: 登记参加明年选举投票的年轻人比 2023 年要少——年轻人是否对民主失去了信心？

short.en: The promoter and broadcaster helped define the music tastes of Australians for decades.
short.zh: 几十年来，发起人和广播公司帮助定义了澳大利亚人的音乐品味。

short.en: Alger Hiss is released from prison after serving 44 months for perjury.
short.zh: 阿尔杰·希斯 (Alger Hiss) 因作伪证罪服刑 44 个月后出狱。

short.en: Clinton–Lewinsky scandal: The United States House of Representatives Judiciary Committee begins impeachment hearings into U.S. President Bill Clinton.
short.zh: 克林顿-莱温斯基丑闻：美国众议院司法委员会开始针对美国总统比尔·克林顿的弹劾听证会。

short.en: A gentleman accepts the responsibility of his actions and bears the burden of their consequences.
In Birmingham, England, Albert, Prince Consort lays the foundation stone of the Birmingham and Midland Institute.
short.zh: 在英国伯明翰，阿尔伯特亲王为伯明翰和米德兰学院奠基。

short.en: The Federal Assembly of Czechoslovakia votes to split the country into the Czech Republic and Slovakia, with effect from January 1, 1993.
short.zh: 捷克斯洛伐克联邦议会投票决定将该国分裂为捷克共和国和斯洛伐克，自 1993 年 1 月 1 日起生效。

short.en: Mexican Revolution: The last of U.S. forces withdraw from Veracruz, occupied seven months earlier in response to the Tampico Affair.
short.zh: 墨西哥革命：最后一批美国军队撤出韦拉克鲁斯，该地此前七个月因坦皮科事件而被占领。

short.en: Bulgarian TABSO Flight 101 crashes near Bratislava, Czechoslovakia, killing all 82 people on board.
short.zh: 保加利亚TABSO 101航班在捷克斯洛伐克布拉迪斯拉发附近坠毁，机上82人全部遇难。

short.en: Bombardment of Yeonpyeong: North Korean artillery attack kills two civilians and two marines on Yeonpyeong Island, South Korea.
short.zh: 延坪岛炮击事件：朝鲜炮击韩国延坪岛，造成两名平民和两名海军陆战队员死亡。

short.en: Battle of Papudo: A Spanish navy schooner is defeated by a Chilean corvette north of Valparaíso, Chile.
Now you see me, now you don't. George thinks he will, but I know he won't!
Frederick II, Holy Roman Emperor, defeats the Lombard League in the battle of Cortenuova.
The siege of Granada, the last Moorish stronghold in Spain, ends with the Treaty of Granada.
World War II: Battle of Stalingrad: General Friedrich Paulus sends Adolf Hitler a telegram saying that the German 6th Army is surrounded.
short.zh: 第二次世界大战：斯大林格勒战役：弗里德里希·保卢斯将军给阿道夫·希特勒发了一封电报，称德国第6集团军被包围。

short.en: Serbo-Bulgarian War: Bulgarian victory in the Battle of Slivnitsa solidifies the unification between the Principality of Bulgaria and Eastern Rumelia.
After eight years of Socialist-led rule, snap elections are taking place on Sunday with conservative Alberto Núñez Feijóo vying to win office.
short.zh: 经过社会党领导的八年统治后，周日将举行提前选举，保守派的阿尔贝托·努涅斯·费乔将争夺总统职位。

short.en: The new series shows how ordinary people deal with friendship, fear, and growing up.
short.zh: 这部新剧展现普通人如何面对友谊、恐惧和成长。
short.note: deal with 应对；growing up 动名词短语。

short.en: The Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) is founded in the Turkish village of Fis.
short.zh: 库尔德工人党（PKK）在土耳其菲斯村成立。

short.en: Lenacapavir, administered as an injection twice a year, is nearly 100% effective at preventing HIV infection.
short.zh: Lenacapavi 每年注射两次，在预防 HIV 感染方面几乎 100% 有效。

long.en: An Azerbaijani MI-8 helicopter carrying 19 peacekeeping mission team with officials and journalists from Russia, Kazakhstan and Azerbaijan is shot down by Armenian military forces in Khojavend District of Azerbaijan.
The Texas Provincial Government authorizes the creation of a horse-mounted police force called the Texas Rangers (which is now the Texas Ranger Division of the Texas Department of Public Safety).
long.zh: 德克萨斯州政府授权建立一支名为德克萨斯游骑兵队（现为德克萨斯州公共安全部德克萨斯游骑兵分部）的骑马警察部队。

long.en: The British fleet under Edward Hawke defeats a French fleet under Hubert de Brienne in the battle of Quiberon Bay, thus diminishing the chances for a French invasion of Britain.
